firmware.title: Agat (eCat)
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev, Mikhail Revzin
firmware.description: Agat-7 and Agat-9, the Soviet Apple II relatives, with their 140 KB and 840 KB disk drives. Emulated by eCat3; ROMs are built in.
firmware.controls: USB keyboard. F11: file browser, F12: settings; a key at power-on picks the model.
